mapper.sql: select r.id, 'READINESS'::text as wait_type, r.tenant_id, r.workflow_definition_id, r.workflow_code, r.calendar_code, r.biz_date, r.wait_status, r.depends_on_job_codes as dependency_job_codes, r.last_error_code as reason_code, null::integer as attempt_count, null::timestamptz as next_attempt_at, r.deadline, r.scheduled_fire_time, r.deferred_since, r.created_at, r.updated_at, r.request_id, coalesce(r.trace_id, tr.trace_id) as trace_id, r.last_error_code, wr.id as workflow_run_id, null::boolean as dry_run from batch.readiness_wait r left join batch.trigger_request tr on tr.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and tr.request_id = r.request_id left join lateral ( select run.id from batch.workflow_run run where run.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and run.trigger_request_id = tr.id order by run.id desc limit 1 ) wr on true where r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} union all select w.id, 'CAPACITY_ADMISSION'::text as wait_type, w.tenant_id, w.workflow_definition_id, definition.workflow_code, null::varchar as calendar_code, w.biz_date, w.wait_status, null::text as dependency_job_codes, 'CAPACITY_LIMIT'::text as reason_code, w.attempt_count, w.next_attempt_at, null::timestamptz as deadline, null::timestamptz as scheduled_fire_time, w.created_at as deferred_since, w.created_at, w.updated_at, w.request_id, tr.trace_id, null::varchar as last_error_code, wr.id as workflow_run_id, w.dry_run from batch.workflow_launch_wait w join batch.workflow_definition definition on definition.tenant_id = w.tenant_id and definition.id = w.workflow_definition_id left join batch.trigger_request tr on tr.tenant_id = w.tenant_id and tr.request_id = w.request_id left join lateral ( select run.id from batch.workflow_run run where run.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and run.trigger_request_id = tr.id order by run.id desc limit 1 ) wr on true where w.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}

select r.id, 'READINESS'::text as wait_type, r.workflow_definition_id, r.biz_date, r.wait_status, r.created_at from batch.readiness_wait r where r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} union all select w.id, 'CAPACITY_ADMISSION'::text as wait_type, w.workflow_definition_id, w.biz_date, w.wait_status, w.created_at from batch.workflow_launch_wait w where w.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}

wait_type = coalesce(cast(#{query.waitType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as varchar), wait_type) and wait_status = coalesce(cast(#{query.waitStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as varchar), wait_status) and workflow_definition_id = coalesce(#{query.workflowDefinitionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, workflow_definition_id) and biz_date >= coalesce(#{query.bizDateFrom,jdbcType=DATE}, biz_date) and biz_date <= coalesce(#{query.bizDateTo,jdbcType=DATE}, biz_date)
